flashcards.back: A full-stack developer is a programmer who specializes in both front-end (client-side) and back-end (server-side) development, handling all aspects of web application development.

Agile and Scrum are iterative and incremental software development methodologies that emphasize flexibility, collaboration, and continuous improvement, focusing on delivering working software in short cycles.
Cloud infrastructure management involves designing, deploying, and managing cloud-based systems, including scaling, security, and optimization, to ensure efficient and reliable operation.
AI and ML involve the development of intelligent systems that can learn, reason, and interact with humans, using techniques such as deep learning, natural language processing, and computer vision.
Project management involves planning, organizing, and controlling resources to achieve specific goals and objectives, using techniques such as Agile, Scrum, and Waterfall methodologies.
